searchText: From ben: We have a patch for this on branch nethermindeth/nethermind:release-1.34.1-rc needs resync; we are still testing and will make official release when is confirmed Can this also happen on mainnet? Which Nethermind release is safe on mainnet? Cc <@&652918665943056397> <@219523277163331586> Please give us some time. We are still investigating the root cause, and in the meantime, we are implementing automatic recovery from this situation. For now, I recommend sticking with the version you are currently using on mainnet. We will keep you posted The answer is yes, but it is not very likely (we had the code with the issue for few months now). Preparix hotfix release. Reason: Optimizing code batching to db in separate thread - optimization from perfnet - rare occasion it might not be saved correctly <@219523277163331586> we will release the fix very soon (we are preparing now), and this will be recommended for production nodes Besides the fix, we have developed an automatic process for this situation (in case a similar bug were to occur). However, since it happened on the testnet, we prefer not to rush the release with recovery. <@628018527470616606> <@758579010027782144> Thanks for the info. Good to hear that you also do parallel work to avoid getting stuck in the future. 🙏 Release is out: https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/releases/tag/1.34.1 Needs resync

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content:
From ben: 

We have a patch for this on branch nethermindeth/nethermind:release-1.34.1-rc needs resync; we are still testing and will make official release when is confirmed

excerpts.author: handelaar2
excerpts.content: Can this also happen on mainnet? Which Nethermind release is safe on mainnet?

excerpts.author: marekm3498
excerpts.content:
<@219523277163331586> Please give us some time. We are still investigating the root cause, and in the meantime, we are implementing automatic recovery from this situation. 

For now, I recommend sticking with the version you are currently using on mainnet. We will keep you posted

excerpts.author: lukaszrozmej
excerpts.content: The answer is yes, but it is not very likely (we had the code with the issue for few months now). Preparix hotfix release.

excerpts.author: lukaszrozmej
excerpts.content: Reason: Optimizing code batching to db in separate thread - optimization from perfnet - rare occasion it might not be saved correctly

excerpts.author: marekm3498
excerpts.content:
<@219523277163331586> we will release the fix very soon (we are preparing now), and this will be recommended for production nodes

Besides the fix, we have developed an automatic process for this situation (in case a similar bug were to occur). However, since it happened on the testnet, we prefer not to rush the release with recovery.

excerpts.author: handelaar2
excerpts.content: <@628018527470616606> <@758579010027782144> Thanks for the info. Good to hear that you also do parallel work to avoid getting stuck in the future. 🙏
